record.title: Prepare a Linux adapter for the reviewed reversible native transitions
record.intent: Preserve the original native transaction while replacing host-specific transport and evidence ownership.
requirements: Read and pin the exact original deploy/remove transaction, pure APK/native/maps/protected-corpus/reader/UI/warm-up/lease validators, current Linux ownership/tool/clock evidence and frozen RF contract. Reuse original stock and derived byte hashes, file metadata, introduction/removal lineage and declared corpus timestamp/CRC/log transition exceptions without widening them. Preparation contacts no specimen or source.

Adapt only ordinary Linux foreground ADB ownership, discovery suppression, explicit remote completion markers, capture/DHCP namespace lifecycle, clock/lease authority and no-retry sequencing. Do not run Mac process/PF/socket adapters on Linux. Preserve one normal reboot per transition, UID-first at most one previously authorized conditional root attempt, one distinct post-root readiness sequence and fresh captured postboot REQUEST/ACK without gateway/DNS.

Keep fixed16-byte O_RDONLY policy observations before and after each transition, full fresh APK/native/corpus/epoch checks, actual normal UI after60s serviced settle and exact1801s serviced warm-up. Require accepted current A1 before B, actual B introduction lineage/arm/postboot lease before A2, and original4800s B plus2400s final-stock reservations under the tighter deadline. No future evidence or acceptance may be fabricated.

Independently review focused host/marker/ownership/lease/clock/budget boundaries and freeze supporting code/config templates. Supply a concrete future binding checklist and exact untested limits; this preparation does not authorize or execute native mutation, reboot, root request, DHCP, ADB, SCPI, physical setup or comparison slots. Actual B/A2 require separate inspected admitted tasking and current gates.
acceptance: A reviewed bounded Linux transition adapter or its precise offline blocker is preserved for a separately admitted physical transition.
